edits.reason: Exclude events where User = CORP\svc_inventory AND ParentImage = C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe. This matches the reviewed false positive(s) ev-2026-11-10-fp-inventory-01, and each must-detect event fails at least one of these conditions.

justification: Exclusion on User = CORP\svc_inventory AND ParentImage = C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe: none of the 2 must-detect events satisfies all of these conditions, so they keep matching. Built from the observed fields of the reviewed events (false positives ev-2026-11-10-fp-inventory-01), using allowed fields the attacker does not control.
expected_effect: Should stop 1 reviewed false positive(s); the 2 must-detect case(s) should still match (local check only, the judge measures).

edited_rule.text: index=winlogs (Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\pwsh.exe") (CommandLine="* -enc *" OR CommandLine="* -EncodedCommand *") NOT (User="CORP\\svc_inventory" AND ParentImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe")
